description:
Confirmed during PR #1198's implementation and its Opus review (2026-07-17).
A repo-wide search finds ZERO production call sites for any adapter's
generate_tuning_clause (singular) mixin — every hit is in tests. Production
rendering flows through the DDL generators' generate_tuning_clauses
(plural; core/dryrun.py, duckdb.py) or #1180's registry-driven paths.

Yet five pre-existing #1180-era registry entries claim physical DDL
rendering via that dead mixin (rendered_via="ddl",
mechanism "adapter_mixin:<Platform>Adapter.generate_tuning_clause"):
postgresql, snowflake, redshift, bigquery, mysql. For postgresql it is
affirmatively false (PostgreSQLAdapter.generate_tuning_clause
unconditionally returns "" - postgresql.py:898-903 - and
apply_table_tunings is a no-op). The others follow the same pattern and
need individual verification. An evaluator consulting the registry (or
`benchbox tuning platforms`, now generated from it) would believe tuned
runs on these platforms physically render tuning DDL when they may not.

Fix: verify each of the five against its real execution path; correct each
entry to honest rendered_via (likely "none" with per-platform notes, or
"ddl" only where a generator is actually consumed at execution); extend
the capability-source drift test so a mechanism claim naming a dead
code path fails (e.g. assert claimed adapter_mixin symbols have
production call sites, or retire the adapter_mixin mechanism vocabulary
entirely in favor of generator-backed mechanisms).

anti_patterns.dont: delete the dead generate_tuning_clause mixins in this item without checking the applied-ledger TODO's instrumentation plans

validate_for_platform behavior for platforms with real tuned rendering (duckdb, clickhouse per #1180)

prior_art.concept: PR #1198: same verify-against-source method applied to the 9 gap platforms
benchbox/core/tuning/capability_registry.py pg-duckdb entry notes: documents the postgresql discrepancy accurately - the pattern for honest notes

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tuning -q -k 'drift or registry'
verifications.description: Registry suite green; corrected entries pinned
verifications.expected: All passing; per-platform corrections listed in PR body

work_units.evidence: Investigated 5 platforms. generate_tuning_clause has ZERO production call sites (only defs+unit tests); real DDL from benchmark.get_create_tables_sql reads tuning_config for PK/FK flags only, never partition/cluster/dist/sort; get_ddl_generator feeds dry-run preview only; apply_unified_tuning is wired (result_capture.py:1751-1753). Reality: snowflake CLUSTERING/PARTITIONING=post_load (ALTER CLUSTER BY snowflake.py:1710); postgresql/redshift/bigquery/mysql=none (mixin ''/apply log-only; no MySQLAdapter class -> NoOpTableTuningMixin).
work_units.summary: Verify each of the five platforms' execution paths; table of claim vs reality with file:line evidence

work_units.evidence: capability_registry.py: 5 entries corrected to honest rendered_via/mechanism/notes with file:line evidence - snowflake->_post_load(apply_table_tunings), postgresql/redshift/bigquery/mysql->_none(<gen>_ddl_generator:preview_only). Tuning-type key SETS preserved exactly -> is_compatible_with_platform unchanged (frozen-baseline test passes). PR #1198 nine none-entries + starrocks entry + EXPECTED_GENERATOR_ONLY_KEYS untouched.
work_units.summary: Correct the five registry entries to honest rendered_via/mechanism; keep is_compatible_with_platform behavior unchanged unless the honest entry requires otherwise (document any behavior delta)

Negative test confirmed red on reintroducing a dead claim. 62 passed (-k drift/registry); 574 passed full core/tuning; ruff/ty clean. Rebased onto #1-merged develop (fast 25383 < cap 25410, no bump).
